_comment: Direction C, Paper desk. Every hex in tokens.css is listed here with the surfaces it is used as text on.

ink.role: Petrol ink. Text, rules, primary button fill, focus ring.

inkSoft.role: Muted text: hints, captions, optional labels.

desk.role: Sunken desk under a stack of slips.

slip.role: Receipt slips and statement paper. The raised surface.

guilloche.role: Hairlines and perforations. A fill, never text.

mint.role: Read-line highlight and the matched stamp fill, under ink text.

stamp.role: Rubber-stamp red. Problems only: needs you, missing, required.

stampWash.role: Behind a field or row that is a problem.

onStamp.role: Text on a stamp fill (nav count badge).
